#Chord Algorithm 
# create possible inversions of a chord
def getInversions(chord):
    options = []
    for i in range(len(chord)):
        inversion = chord[i:] + [note + 12 for note in chord[:i]]
        options.append(inversion)
    return options

# Calculate distance between two chord arrangements
def chordDistance(chord1, chord2):
    distance = 0
    for i in range(len(chord1)):
        distance += abs(chord1[i] - chord2[i])
    return distance

# Select inversion with the smallest note movement
def smoothChord(chord, previous):
    options = getInversions(chord)
    best = options[0]
    bestDistance = chordDistance(best, previous)
    for option in options[1:]:
        distance = chordDistance(option, previous)
        if distance < bestDistance:
            best = option
            bestDistance = distance
    return best

# Play progression with automatic chord arrangement
def playProgression(progression, durations, velocity):
    previous = progression[0]
    playNote(previous, beats=durations[0], velocity=velocity)
    for i in range(1, len(progression)):
        newChord = smoothChord(progression[i], previous)
        playNote(newChord, beats=durations[i], velocity=velocity)
        previous = newChord
